# Get Coverage by Grid from Orthos

## Pre-processing

See Pre-processing.Rmd

## Vegetation indices

For each orthophoto, apply preprocessing, then get NDVI from standard formula.

Preprocessing:

1.  Mask glint areas based on the attached polygon, assign these to -1 on NDVI
2.  Mask shadows by filtering by low NIR values, assign these -1 on NDVI
3.  Mask terrestrial areas from the VegClassPoly, assign these to NA

### NDAVI / WAVI

These are just NDVI except with blue instead of red. They seem to work better at detecting floating-leaved vegetation in deep water, but struggle with differentiating from glint and shallow water compared to NDVI.

### GNDVI

This index, the also called "NDWI" and usually used to differentiate water from other non-vegetated areas, was useful in this Korean aquatic veg study (Song and Park 2020), it's just NDVI but with green instead of red

### EVI

Coefficient values from <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rsase.2025.101711>: G=2.5, L=0.16, C1 = 6, C2 = 7.5

$$\text{EVI}=G \times \frac {(\text{NIR}-\text{Red})} {({\text{NIR}} + C_{1} \times {\text{Red}}-C_{2} \times {\text{Blue}}+L)}$$

```{r}
# Helper functions for shadows and glint masking
maskShadows <- function(index, nir, shadow_threshold = 0.015){
  ifel(nir < shadow_threshold, -1, index)
}
maskGlint <- function(ndvi, glint_mask_path){
  glint <- vect(glint_mask_path)
  
  # Boolean subsets 
  glint_veg   <- glint[glint$contains_veg %in% TRUE]
  glint_water <- glint[!(glint$contains_veg %in% TRUE)]
  
  # Glint with vegetation -> NA (exclude from analysis)
  if (nrow(glint_veg) > 0) {
    ndvi <- mask(ndvi, glint_veg, inverse = TRUE, updatevalue = NA)
  }
  # Glint without vegetation -> -1 (treat as water)
  if (nrow(glint_water) > 0) {
    ndvi <- mask(ndvi, glint_water, inverse = TRUE, updatevalue = -1)
  }
  ndvi
}

getNdviFromOrtho <- function(merged, shadow_threshold, glint_mask_path){
  nir <- merged[[4]]
  red <- merged[[1]]
  ndvi <- (nir - red) / (nir + red)
  
  # mask shadows by minimum NIR value, set to -1
  ndvi <- maskShadows(ndvi, nir, shadow_threshold)
  
  # mask glint areas if they exist, set to -1
  if(file.exists(glint_mask_path)){
    ndvi <- maskGlint(ndvi, glint_mask_path)
  }
  
  names(ndvi) <- "ndvi"
  return(ndvi)
}

getNdaviFromOrtho <- function(merged, glint_mask_path){
  nir <- merged[[4]]
  blue <- merged[[3]]
  ndavi <- (nir - blue) / (nir + blue)
  
  # mask glint areas if they exist, set to -1
  if(file.exists(glint_mask_path)){
    ndavi <- maskGlint(ndavi, glint_mask_path)
  }
  names(ndavi) <- "ndavi"
  return(ndavi)
}

getWaviFromOrtho <- function(merged, glint_mask_path, G=2.5, L=1){
  nir <- merged[[4]]
  blue <- merged[[3]]
  wavi <- (1+L) * (nir - blue) / (nir + blue + L)
  
  # mask glint areas if they exist, set to -1
  if(file.exists(glint_mask_path)){
    wavi <- maskGlint(wavi, glint_mask_path)
  }
  names(wavi) <- "wavi"
  return(wavi)
}

getGndviFromOrtho <- function(merged, glint_mask_path){
  nir <- merged[[4]]
  green <- merged[[2]]
  gndvi <- (nir - green) / (nir + green)
  
  # mask glint areas if they exist, set to -1
  if(file.exists(glint_mask_path)){
    gndvi <- maskGlint(gndvi, glint_mask_path)
  }
  names(gndvi) <- "gndvi"
  return(gndvi)
}

getEviFromOrtho <- function(merged, glint_mask_path, G=2.5,  L=0.16){
  nir <- merged[[4]]
  blue <- merged[[3]]
  red <- merged[[1]]
  evi <- G * (nir - red) / (nir + (6*red) - (7.5*blue) + L)
  
  # mask shadows by minimum NIR value, set to -1
  evi <- maskShadows(evi, nir)
  # mask glint areas if they exist, set to -1
  if(file.exists(glint_mask_path)){
    evi <- maskGlint(evi, glint_mask_path)
  }
  names(evi) <- "evi"
  return(evi)
}

getEviNoTt <-function(evi, Tt){
  eviNoTt <- mask(evi, Tt, inverse=TRUE, updatevalue = NA)
  return(eviNoTt)
}
```

## Grid over lake

Generate a 10x10m grid covering the image area bounding box. Remove grid cells which don't overlap the lake area. Round the extent coordinates to multiples of 10 (Finnish CRS) so they all align with each other

TODO: restrict this to the image extent? For example for the very large lakes we just did a small area of

```{r}
getLakeGrid <- function(ndvi_bbox){
  # Get corner 
  corner <- st_bbox(ndvi_bbox)[c("xmin", "ymin")]
  # round to ten to align with other grids
  grid_corner <- round(corner/10, 0)*10
  
  lake_grid <- st_make_grid(ndvi_bbox, cellsize=10, offset=grid_corner)
  return (lake_grid)
}
```

## Fractional coverage

Using the following algorithm, get the fractional coverage over the grid.

$$c=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n f_i 
\begin{cases}
    1,  &0.6 \le x_i \\
    \frac{x_i}{(0.6-0.1)}, & 0.1 \le x_i  <  0.6 \\
    0, & x_i < 0.1
\end{cases}$$

```{r}
getFractionalCoverage <- function(ndvi, grid){
  # First apply the classification to the NDVI
  cutoffs <- c(0, 0.6)
  classifiedNDVI <- ifel(ndvi < cutoffs[1], 0,
                         ifel(ndvi < cutoffs[2], ndvi / (cutoffs[2] - cutoffs[1]), 1))
  print("classfied NDVI")
  # set output field name
  names(classifiedNDVI) <- "coverage"   
  
  # Now do zonal stats to get mean over the grid
  # TODO: Differentiate between 1 nodata pixel (ignore in mean)
  zonalOut <- zonal(classifiedNDVI, grid, fun="mean", na.rm=TRUE, as.polygons=TRUE)
  return(zonalOut)
}
```

## Execute functions over all ortho

```{r}
# Define helper function to fall back on the cache.export intermediates if exists and specified
cacheFallback = function(stepFunction, stepArgs, stepOutfile, useCache, exportIntermediates){
  if (useCache & file.exists(stepOutfile)) {
    # Read from output folder if exists and specified
    print(paste(stepOutfile, "already exists"))
    stepOutObject <- rast(stepOutfile)
  } else {
    # Else call the function to generate, and export if specified
    stepOutObject <- do.call(stepFunction, stepArgs)
    if (exportIntermediates) {
      print(paste("Exporting", stepOutfile))
      writeRaster(stepOutObject, stepOutfile, overwrite=TRUE)
      }
  }
  return(stepOutObject)
}

# Define function to export coverage from ortho
exportCoverageFromOrthos <- function(lakeDir, useCache=TRUE, exportIntermediates=TRUE, skipCompleted=TRUE){
  outdir = file.path(lakeDir, "outputs")
  dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  outCoverageGpkg = paste("coverages_",Sys.Date(),".gpkg", sep="")
  outCoverageLayer = basename(lakeDir)
  
  # Starting point is the "georeferenced" merged image, if it exists
  # For some of the orthos, I didn't manually georeference them, so use the non-updated version
  georefOrtho <- file.path(outdir, 
                           paste("merged_clamped_georef_", basename(lakeDir), ".tif", sep=""))
  mergedOrtho <- file.path(outdir, 
                           paste("merged_clamped_", basename(lakeDir), ".tif", sep=""))
  if (file.exists(georefOrtho)) {
    merged <- rast(georefOrtho)
  } else {
    merged <- rast(mergedOrtho)
  }
  
  # Try to check existing layers
  existing_layers <- tryCatch(
    st_layers(outCoverageGpkg)$name,
    error = function(e) list()  # Returns empty list if file doesn't exist yet
  )
  
  # Skip this layer if specified and the output already exists
  if (skipCompleted & outCoverageLayer %in% existing_layers){
    print(paste("Already completed", outCoverageLayer))
    return()
  } else {
    print(outCoverageLayer)
    
    # Generate NDVI
    glint_mask_path <- file.path(lakeDir, "glint-mask.gpkg")
    ndvi <- cacheFallback(getNdviFromOrtho, 
                          list(
                            merged = merged,
                            shadow_threshold = 0.015, 
                            glint_mask_path = glint_mask_path), 
                          file.path(outdir, "ndvi.tif"),
                          useCache, exportIntermediates
    )
    print(paste("Got NDVI", outCoverageLayer))
    gc()
    
    # Generate NDAVI
    ndavi <- cacheFallback(getNdaviFromOrtho, 
                           list(
                             merged = merged,
                             glint_mask_path = glint_mask_path), 
                           file.path(outdir, "ndavi.tif"),
                           useCache, exportIntermediates
    )
    
    # Generate WAVI
    wavi <- cacheFallback(getWaviFromOrtho, 
                          list(
                            merged = merged,
                            glint_mask_path = glint_mask_path), 
                          file.path(outdir, "wavi.tif"),
                          useCache, exportIntermediates
    )
    # Generate WAVI
    gndvi <- cacheFallback(getGndviFromOrtho, 
                          list(
                            merged = merged,
                            glint_mask_path = glint_mask_path), 
                          file.path(outdir, "gndvi.tif"),
                          useCache, exportIntermediates
    )
    # Generate EVI
    evi <- cacheFallback(getEviFromOrtho, 
                          list(
                            merged = merged,
                            glint_mask_path = glint_mask_path), 
                          file.path(outdir, "evi.tif"),
                          useCache, exportIntermediates
    )
    # Mask terrestrial areas from EVI
    eviMask <- cacheFallback(getEviNoTt,
                             list(
                               evi = evi, 
                               Tt = Tt),
                             file.path(outdir, "evi_masked.tif"),
                             useCache, exportIntermediates
                             )
    gc()
    # Remove merged grid from memory
    rm(merged)

    # Generate grid
    ndvi_bbox <- st_as_sf(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(ndvi)))
    grid <- getLakeGrid(ndvi_bbox)
    coverage <- getFractionalCoverage(evi, vect(grid))
    print("Got EVI coverage grid")

    # Write coverage grid to gpkg
    writeVector(
      coverage,
      filename=outCoverageGpkg,
      layer=outCoverageLayer,
      insert=TRUE,
      overwrite=TRUE
    )
    gc()
    return()
  }
}
```

# Classify Grid coverage

1.  Manually combine all the field notes into polygon fields representing the extents of different plant species, and also the lake boundaries. Add the land area as a polygon

2.  Join to the coverage grid from earlier, adding an attribute for each class. This attribute is calculated from the following formula for species $k$: $$ c_{k_1} =  \frac{A_{k_1} \bar{c}_{k_1}} {\sum_{k=1} ^ n A_k \bar c_k}  c $$

    Where $c_k$ is the coverage for species $k$, $A_k$ is the intersection of the area polygon with this cell, $\sum A$ is the total area of all polygons overlapping this cell, $\bar {c_k}$ is the average coverage for cells containing ONLY species $k$, and $c$ is the overall coverage as calculated from NDVI above. Note that if only one species is present, $A_k = \sum A$ and $\bar c_k = \sum \bar c$

    We still need to account for different species having different densities - perhaps multi species cells should be handled as their own case?

```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

Function to create a classified grid

TODO: Add coefficient for relative veg converage densities. Calculated similar to area, but using the mean coverage of single-species cells

```{r}
classifyGrid <- function(gpkg, lake, classes){
  grid = st_read(gpkg, layer=lake)
  # Verify overlap and CRS
  classes <- classes |> st_transform(st_crs(grid)) |> st_make_valid()
  
  grid <- grid |>
    mutate(grid_id = row_number())
  
  # ---- 1. Overlay: one row per (grid cell x class polygon) piece ---------
  pieces <- st_intersection(
    select(grid, grid_id),
    select(classes, Class)
  ) |>
    st_collection_extract("POLYGON") |>  # drop stray lines/points from edge touches
    mutate(area = as.numeric(st_area(geom))) |>
    st_drop_geometry()
  
  # ---- 2. Weights per cell ------------------------------------------------
  class_cov <- pieces |>
    group_by(grid_id, Class) |>
    summarise(area = sum(area), .groups = "drop") |>   # merge multiple polys of same class
    group_by(grid_id) |>
    mutate(weight = area / sum(area)) |> 
    ungroup() |>
    left_join(st_drop_geometry(grid) |> select(grid_id, coverage), by = "grid_id") |>
    mutate(class_coverage = coverage * weight) |>
    select(grid_id, Class, class_coverage)
  
  # TODO: Add correction based on expected density per class.
  
  # ---- 3. Unknown: coverage but no class polygon ---------------------------
  unknown <- grid |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    filter(coverage > 0, !grid_id %in% class_cov$grid_id) |>
    transmute(grid_id, Class = "unknown", class_coverage = coverage)
  
  # ---- 4. Wide format and join back to the grid ----------------------------
  wide <- bind_rows(class_cov, unknown) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = Class, values_from = class_coverage, values_fill = 0)
  
  class_cols <- setdiff(names(wide), "grid_id")
  
  grid_out <- grid |>
    left_join(wide, by = "grid_id") |>
    mutate(across(all_of(class_cols), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))
  
  # Check that all classes add up to total coverage
  check <- grid_out |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    mutate(total = rowSums(across(all_of(class_cols))),
           diff  = abs(total - coverage))
  stopifnot(all(check$diff < 1e-9 | is.na(check$diff)))
  
  # st_write(grid_out, "coverage_by_class_1.gpkg", layer = lake, delete_layer = TRUE)
  
  # TODO: Drop all NA coverages
  return(grid_out)
}
```

```{r}
# Define starting variables
orthos_path = "/media/northross/New Volume/Orthos"
lakeDirs.list = list.dirs(orthos_path, recursive=FALSE)[1:25]

classes = st_read('gpkg/VegClassPolys.gpkg', layer="VegClassPolys")
coverages_gpkg = 'coverages_2026-11-21.gpkg'

datalist <- vector("list", length=25)

for (lakeDir in lakeDirs.list){
  lake <- basename(lakeDir)
  lakeGrid <- classifyGrid(coverages_gpkg, lake, classes)
  # Add column for lakeID
  groupID <- as.integer(substr(lake, 0, 2))
  lakeGrid$groupID <- groupID
  datalist[[groupID]] <- lakeGrid
}

classified_coverages <- bind_rows(datalist)
st_write(classified_coverages, "coverage_by_class.gpkg", delete_layer = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# group by lake ID and get sum
cov_by_lake <- classified_coverages |>  
  filter(!is.na(coverage)) |>
  select(groupID,coverage, Nu, Spg) |>
  group_by(groupID) |>
  summarise(
    Nu = sum(Nu/coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
    NuMean = mean(Nu, na.rm = TRUE), NuSd = sd(Nu, na.rm = TRUE),
    Spg = sum(Spg/coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
    SpgMean = mean(Spg, na.rm = TRUE), SpgSd = sd(Spg, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
